changes.summary: expose worktree tool release history offline
changes.body:
Run `honeycomb changelog` to inspect recorded changes without a repository.
Use its help for version selection, pagination and JSON output.

changes.summary: quote preserved source messages in squash commits
changes.body:
Honeycomb appends the source branch and archived commit messages after
the caller's reviewed squash body. For Hive release generation, archived
changelog blocks are provenance: only top-level `changelog v1` blocks
declare the integrated commit's tool changes.

For example, a block in the reviewed squash body can contain a shell example:

~~~~text
~~~changelog v1
feat(honeycomb): describe the consumer-visible change

Explain the change and any required or optional adoption actions.

```sh
honeycomb changelog
```
~~~
~~~~

The record format version `v1` is independent of the Hive suite version.
breaking: Every preserved source-message line now has a Markdown blockquote prefix (`> `). Consumers that parse Honeycomb squash-message archives must account for this format change.

adoption.text: For Hive changelog authors: put the authoritative top-level changelog v1 blocks in the final reviewed squash body passed to honeycomb finish --body, with a separate single-tool Conventional Commit header for each affected tool. This is a Hive release-authoring requirement, not a requirement for other repositories using Honeycomb.
